in_sanskrit.name: Periyasamy
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Great Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Periyasamy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who possesses the great knowledge and power of a master

in_hindi.name: Periyasamy
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Great Master
in_hindi.long_meaning: Periyasamy एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who possesses the great knowledge and power of a master

in_tamil.name: பெரியாசாமி
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has great knowledge and experience, an elder or senior master.

in_telugu.name: Periyasamy
in_telugu.long_meaning: Periyasamy ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who possesses the great knowledge and power of a master

in_marathi.name: Periyasamy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Periyasamy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses the great knowledge and power of a master

in_bengali.name: Periyasamy
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Great Master
